main|heldout_A1.text: Stay clear of the space above the notebook computer.

main|heldout_A2.text: Make sure the cup never travels over the laptop.

main|heldout_A3.text: The beverage must not be carried across the top of the computer.

main|heldout_A4.text: Route around the keyboard rather than over it.

main|heldout_A5.text: Liquids should never be moved over electronic devices.

main|heldout_A7.text: Keep the drink away from the airspace over the PC.

main|heldout_B1.text: Don't let the drink slosh out.

main|heldout_B3.text: The mug should stay level the whole time.

main|heldout_B4.text: No tipping or tilting of the cup during transport.

main|heldout_B5.text: Carry it as if it were full to the brim.

main|heldout_B6.text: Ensure the beverage container remains upright.

main|heldout2_A0.text: Do not let the mug hover over the laptop at any point.

main|heldout2_A1.text: Keep anything you carry off the space above the computer.

main|heldout2_A2.text: Detour so the cup is never above the notebook.

main|heldout2_A3.text: Avoid moving the drink over the screen and keyboard.

main|heldout2_A4.text: Spills on the laptop would ruin it, so never pass over it.

main|heldout2_A5.text: Take a path that doesn't cross over the laptop.

main|heldout2_A6.text: Steer clear of the computer when moving the cup.

main|heldout2_A7.text: Never transport the beverage above the device.

main|heldout2_B2.text: The cup must not lean while you move it.

main|heldout2_B4.text: Avoid any tilting motion with the mug.

main|heldout2_B5.text: Keep the mug's opening facing up.

main|heldout2_B7.text: Make sure the coffee stays inside the mug.
